excluded_apps.name: glyph_2x_hi

excluded_apps.name: glyph_2x_lo
excluded_apps.reason: DEV COMPARISON TILE, 2026-08-22, one of four: `glyph` at 32x12/LORES, which is the retired `glyph2x` app's exact mode and has had no tile since the 2026-08-21 consolidation. It is also the ONLY configuration anywhere that reaches the natively authored 5x10 mask bank (`assets2x/glyph-masks-2x.pfb`), which the density-flip report calls dead weight on a HIRES-only payload -- here it is live.

toolchain.determinism_caveat: The v3.0.2 UF2 is pinned to the PUBLIC RELEASE asset, not to the image the fleet is flashed with. Pimoroni's CI builds picovector from a floating `main`, so two images tagged v3.0.2 need not be byte-identical. Naming the exact production UF2 is an OPEN ASK to Pimoroni; until it is answered, a first-article check against a production-flashed unit is the only thing that closes the gap.
